name: Custom LOLA south-pole terrain, 200 km at 1024 px (LOLA LDEM_80S_80M)
source: NASA LRO LOLA polar gridded product, PDS Geosciences Node (lro-l-lola-3-rdr-v1/lrolol_1xxx/data/lola_gdr/polar/jp2)
datumNote: Elevation values are meters relative to the 1737400 m reference radius (LOLA shape model). Source DNs have SCALING_FACTOR 0.5; this grid stores elevation in meters (1 m resolution) already scaled.

formula.lonLatToXY: rho = 2 * R * tan(pi/4 + lat/2); x = rho * sin(lon); y = rho * cos(lon)
formula.xyToLonLat: rho = hypot(x, y); lon = atan2(x, y); lat = 2 * atan(rho / (2 * R)) - pi/2
formula.units: meters for x/y, radians inside formulas

grid.rowOrder: row 0 = maxY (north edge), increasing row = decreasing y
grid.colOrder: col 0 = minX (west edge), increasing col = increasing x
